## How to read the comparisons

- Keep earlier additions; report gains and regressions.
- SKU dropout stays at **50%** after introduction.
- All tests train for **up to 40 epochs**; early stopping may end runs sooner.
- Step tables: same split, seed 42, batch 1,024.
- Rows: **349,975 train / 74,736 validation / 75,289 test**.
- Fit preprocessing on training data; select by validation.
- Early steps use final weights; step 6 adds best-checkpoint selection.
- Final confirmation: **three seeds** with the same training budget.

## 0. Baseline

Three sigmoid hidden layers: **256 / 128 / 64** neurons. SKU/category embeddings, standardized raw inputs, linear output, and Adam at 0.001.

| Model | Validation $R^2$ | Validation RMSE |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Basic model | 0.3636 | 39.69 |

No added feature engineering, dropout, L2, clipping, rate reductions, early stopping, or best-epoch selection.

## 1. Add log features

Add log1p versions of price, order, and duration alongside the raw inputs. Fit scaling on training data only.

| Model | Validation $R^2$ | Validation RMSE |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Before addition | 0.3636 | 39.69 |
| After addition | 0.3336 | 40.62 |

**Change:** $R^2$ -0.0299, RMSE +0.92.

## 2. Add square-root features

Add square-root versions of price, order, and duration. The model now has nine numeric inputs.

| Model | Validation $R^2$ | Validation RMSE |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Before addition | 0.3336 | 40.62 |
| After addition | 0.3389 | 40.46 |

**Change:** $R^2$ +0.0053, RMSE -0.16.

## 3. Add hidden dropout

Drop **5%** of activations after each hidden layer during training. Keep this rate in every later model.

| Model | Validation $R^2$ | Validation RMSE |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Before addition | 0.3389 | 40.46 |
| After addition | 0.4046 | 38.39 |

**Change:** $R^2$ +0.0657, RMSE -2.06.

## 4. Add SKU dropout

Drop the whole SKU embedding for **50%** of training examples. Keep **50%** in every later model.

| Model | Validation $R^2$ | Validation RMSE |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Before addition | 0.4046 | 38.39 |
| After addition | 0.5837 | 32.10 |

**Change:** $R^2$ +0.1791, RMSE -6.29.

## 5. Add L2 penalties

Add a **0.0001 L2 penalty** to hidden-layer kernels. Evaluation RMSE excludes the penalty.

| Model | Validation $R^2$ | Validation RMSE |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Before addition | 0.5837 | 32.10 |
| After addition | 0.5996 | 31.49 |

**Change:** $R^2$ +0.0159, RMSE -0.62.

## 6. Add validation-based training controls

Keep the best validation checkpoint: **epoch 15**. This combined step also includes norm clipping at 10, learning-rate reductions, and early stopping with patience 12.

| Model | Validation $R^2$ | Validation RMSE |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Before addition | 0.5996 | 31.49 |
| After addition | 0.6177 | 30.77 |

**Change:** $R^2$ +0.0181, RMSE -0.72.

## 7. Switch Adam to RMSprop

Switch **Adam to RMSprop**, keeping the initial learning rate at **0.001** and all other settings fixed.

| Model | Validation $R^2$ | Validation RMSE |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Before addition | 0.6177 | 30.77 |
| After addition | 0.6210 | 30.63 |

**Change:** $R^2$ +0.0033, RMSE -0.13.

## 8. Reduce the L2 penalty

Lower the hidden-kernel L2 coefficient from **0.0001 to 0.00001**. Keep RMSprop and the previous settings.

| Model | Validation $R^2$ | Validation RMSE |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Before addition | 0.6210 | 30.63 |
| After addition | 0.6217 | 30.60 |

**Change:** $R^2$ +0.0007, RMSE -0.03.

## Confirm the improvement across three seeds

**Compare seed 42 with the three-seed average.**

| Configuration | Seed 42: $R^2$ | 3-seed mean: $R^2$ |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Adam + L2 0.0001 (step 6) | 0.6177 | 0.6170 |
| RMSprop + L2 0.00001 (step 8) | 0.6217 | 0.6222 |

**Matched confirmation gain:** mean $R^2$ **+0.0053**, positive in **all three seeds**.

The seed-42 scores continue directly from steps 6 and 8. The right column averages seeds 42, 101, and 202.

## Final model: distinguish the reported scores

**Chosen configuration:** RMSprop + L2 0.00001 (step 8).

**Packaged checkpoint:** seed 202, epoch 26; selected using validation.

| Reported score | $R^2$ | RMSE | MAE |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| Three-seed mean validation | 0.6222 | 30.58 | -- |
| Selected checkpoint: validation | 0.6235 | 30.53 | 12.51 |
| Selected checkpoint: test | 0.6245 | 31.40 | 12.74 |

The mean summarizes repeatability across seeds. The other rows evaluate the saved checkpoint on validation and test data.

## Other experiments: changes that did not help

**Each test starts from the same RMSprop model.**

| Tested change | Before $R^2$ | After $R^2$ | Change |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| Seven sigmoid layers | 0.6210 | $\approx 0$ | -0.6210 |
| L2 penalty 0.001 | 0.6210 | 0.5981 | -0.0229 |
| Batch size 4,096 | 0.6210 | 0.6194 | -0.0016 |
| Batch norm before activation | 0.6210 | 0.6156 | -0.0054 |

**Matched parent:** RMSprop with L2 0.0001, validation $R^2$ **0.6210**. Each row changes one setting from this model; the changes do not accumulate. Same split, seed 42, and training budget.

## Evaluation

- RMSE uses supplied quantity units and excludes L2 penalties.
- Validation selects settings; test scoring follows frozen selection. The test set has historical exposure.
- Predictions describe completed selling episodes, not advance forecasts.
- Results apply to this setup and budget; all trials remain logged.


Exact tuning values and whole-SKU masking are project choices.
